preconditions.description: The input word must be a string.
The length of the word must be greater than 0 and less than 1000.

postconditions.expression: return_value == word[len(word)//2] if len(word) % 2 == 1 else word[len(word)//2 - 1:len(word)//2 + 1]
postconditions.description: If the word length is odd, return the single middle character. If the word length is even, return the two middle characters.
